The main concept of this Azorius Aggro deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence while utilizing powerful artifacts to boost your creatures and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With cards like The Reality Chip and The Celestus, you can quickly overwhelm your opponent with strong creatures like Stenn, Paranoid Partisan and Urza, Lord Protector. Cityscape Leveler and Thran Spider provide additional utility, while Relic of Legends and Portal to Phyrexia can help control the battlefield. By combining creature aggression with artifact synergy, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver your opponent to secure victory.
